> **The problem with pilot schemes**
> 
> **A.** Governments increasingly test policies before adopting them. A new scheme is introduced in a few districts, results are measured, and if the outcome is positive the policy is extended nationally. The approach seems obviously sensible, and in medicine, where the method originated, it has transformed practice.
> 
> **B.** Social policy, however, differs from medicine in an important respect. A drug behaves the same way in a trial as it does afterwards. A policy does not. Pilot schemes are typically run by enthusiastic staff who volunteered, in areas selected partly because success was thought likely, and with levels of funding and attention that could never be sustained nationally. When the scheme is extended, none of these conditions apply.
> 
> **C.** Researchers have a name for the resulting disappointment: the scale-up effect. In a review of over a hundred programmes across several countries, the average effect after national rollout was less than half that recorded in the pilot. In roughly one case in five, the effect disappeared entirely. Notably, the programmes that shrank most were those that had depended heavily on the skill of particular individuals.
> 
> **D.** Some approaches reduce the problem. Trials can be run in randomly chosen areas rather than volunteers, and staffed by ordinary employees rather than specialists. Costs can be calculated at the level required for national delivery rather than the level actually spent. These measures make pilots less likely to succeed, which is precisely why they are politically unpopular: a minister who commissions a trial usually hopes to announce a success.
> 
> **E.** The deeper lesson is not that pilots are useless but that a positive result answers a narrower question than it appears to. It shows that a policy can work under favourable conditions with committed staff. Whether it will work everywhere, delivered by everyone, at a cost the state can afford, remains unanswered.

writing.de_tom_tat: Task 1, ≥150 từ: biểu đồ đường có 2 đường trong giai đoạn 20 năm (dân số đô thị và nông thôn).
writing.bai_mau:
The line graph shows changes in the urban and rural population of a country over a twenty-year period from 2000 to 2020, measured in millions.

Overall, the urban population grew substantially while the rural population fell, and the two lines crossed at around 2012, after which city dwellers formed the majority.

In 2000, the rural population stood at approximately 45 million, considerably higher than the urban figure of 28 million. Over the following decade, the rural total declined slowly but consistently, reaching 40 million by 2010. The urban population, in contrast, rose steadily throughout the same period, climbing to 38 million.

The point of intersection occurred in 2012, when both figures stood at roughly 39 million. Thereafter the trends diverged more sharply. Urban numbers accelerated, reaching a peak of 52 million in 2020, whereas the rural population dropped more rapidly, falling to just 32 million — its lowest level in the period and a decline of nearly 30 per cent overall.

The most striking feature is the complete reversal of the two populations: the gap of 17 million in favour of rural areas in 2000 had become a gap of 20 million in favour of cities by 2020.

cham_diem.vi_sao: Có Overview nêu xu hướng và điểm giao nhau — chi tiết quan trọng nhất của biểu đồ hai đường. Nêu đủ mốc đầu, giao, đỉnh, cuối. Câu cuối định lượng sự đảo chiều bằng con số cụ thể.
Chia theo giai đoạn trước và sau điểm giao — cách nhóm hợp lý nhất cho biểu đồ hai đường. Từ nối: Over the following decade · in contrast · Thereafter · whereas.
stood at · declined slowly but consistently · rose steadily · point of intersection · trends diverged · accelerated · reaching a peak · in favour of.
Quá khứ hoàn thành (had become) · mệnh đề quan hệ (after which city dwellers formed) · mệnh đề rút gọn (climbing to, falling to, measured in millions) · so sánh (considerably higher than).

dang_hoc: Biểu đồ hai đường giao nhau thì điểm giao là chi tiết quan trọng nhất — phải nêu trong Overview.
Chia bài theo giai đoạn (trước giao / sau giao) chứ không theo từng đường — dễ so sánh hơn hẳn.
"in favour of" để diễn đạt bên nào cao hơn: "a gap of 17 million in favour of rural areas".
Câu cuối nên định lượng sự thay đổi, không chỉ nhận xét chung.
loi_thuong_gap: ❌ Không nêu điểm giao nhau → bỏ mất đặc điểm quan trọng nhất.
❌ Tả riêng từng đường từ đầu đến cuối → không so sánh được.
❌ Viết dài quá 200 từ → hết thời gian cho Task 2 (chiếm 2/3 điểm Writing).
❌ Không có Overview → trần band 5 cho Task Achievement.

speaking.de_tom_tat: Checkpoint Level 3 — Part 2 (2 phút): Describe a change you have seen in your country. Part 3 tiếp theo.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: Part 2 — Describe a change you have seen in your country (2 phút)
cau_tra_loi.mau:
I'd like to describe the growth of cities in Vietnam, which I've watched happen over my own lifetime.

When I was a child in Can Tho, most people I knew worked in agriculture or small trade. The city was quiet, and Ho Chi Minh City felt genuinely far away.

Over the past twenty years that has changed completely. Millions have moved to the cities for work — I'm one of them. The urban population overtook the rural one about ten years ago, and you can see the effect everywhere: new apartment blocks, constant construction, far heavier traffic.

The benefits are real. There are far more job opportunities, and services like healthcare and education are considerably better. But there are costs too — housing has become unaffordable for young people, and the air quality in the centre is noticeably worse than it was.

On balance I think the change has been positive, but it has happened faster than the infrastructure could cope with. That's the real problem.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Dàn ý Part 2 cho đề mô tả thay đổi: bối cảnh trước → thay đổi gì → hệ quả tốt → hệ quả xấu → đánh giá. Năm phần × ~25 giây. Dùng quá khứ đơn cho "trước", hiện tại hoàn thành cho "đã thay đổi".

cau_tra_loi.mau: Largely, yes — it follows economic opportunity. But the pace can be managed. If rural areas had better internet and services, fewer people would feel forced to leave. Remote work has made that more realistic than it was ten years ago.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Trả lời dứt khoát, rồi nêu điều có thể can thiệp. Điều kiện loại 2 đúng ngữ cảnh.

cham_diem.vi_sao: Part 2 nói liền 2 phút, năm phần rõ ràng, chuyển ý bằng từ nối tự nhiên.
agriculture · overtook · unaffordable · infrastructure · cope with · inevitable.
Phối hợp ba thì: quá khứ đơn (was, worked) · hiện tại hoàn thành (has changed, Millions have moved) · điều kiện loại 2 (If rural areas had… fewer people would feel).

meo_noi: Đây là checkpoint Level 3, mục tiêu band 5.0–5.5. Nói trôi bài này là bạn đã vượt mục tiêu.
Đề "describe a change" luôn cần ba thì: quá khứ (trước), hiện tại hoàn thành (đã đổi), hiện tại (bây giờ).
Câu cuối "That's the real problem" — chốt lại bằng câu ngắn, rất mạnh sau một đoạn dài.
